title: Nourishing Smoky Australian Chicken Skewers
description: A low-fat friendly Australian dish featuring smoky chicken skewers grilled on a robata grill and served with a tangy green salsa, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the chicken skewers.
Grill the chicken skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 165 degrees.
Meanwhile, heat the green salsa in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, place the skewers on a salt block to keep warm.
Serve the chicken skewers with the warm green salsa spooned over the top.
